entities.summary: Esther Hicks is an American motivational speaker, channeler, and author. She has co-written nine books with her husband Jerry Hicks, presented many workshops on the law of attraction with Abraham-Hicks Publications, and has also appeared in the original cut of the 2006 film The Secret. Hicks claims to channel a collective consciousness she calls "Abraham". As with other channellers, she uses a different tone of voice and accent to indicate the entity is speaking through her.
